195	/**
196	 * Resolve a plugin by either database ID or plugin key.
197	 *
198	 * Lookup order:
199	 * - UUID-like IDs: getById first, then getByKey.
200	 * - Scoped package keys (e.g. "@scope/name"): getByKey only, never getById.
201	 * - Other non-UUID IDs: try getById first (test/memory registries may allow this),
202	 *   then fallback to getByKey. Any UUID parse error from getById is ignored.
203	 *
204	 * @param registry - The plugin registry service instance
205	 * @param pluginId - Either a database UUID or plugin key (manifest id)
206	 * @returns Plugin record or null if not found
207	 */
208	async function resolvePlugin(
209	  registry: ReturnType<typeof pluginRegistryService>,
210	  pluginId: string,
211	) {
212	  const isUuid = UUID_REGEX.test(pluginId);
213	  const isScopedPackageKey = pluginId.startsWith("@") || pluginId.includes("/");
214	
215	  if (isScopedPackageKey && !isUuid) {
216	    return registry.getByKey(pluginId);
217	  }
218	
219	  try {
220	    const byId = await registry.getById(pluginId);
221	    if (byId) return byId;
222	  } catch (error) {
223	    const maybeCode =
224	      typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "code" in error
225	        ? (error as { code?: unknown }).code
226	        : undefined;
227	    if (maybeCode !== "22P02") {
228	      throw error;
229	    }
230	  }
231	
232	  return registry.getByKey(pluginId);
233	}

322	/**
323	 * Create Express router for plugin management API.
324	 *
325	 * Routes provided:
326	 *
327	 * | Method | Path | Description |
328	 * |--------|------|-------------|
329	 * | GET | /plugins | List all plugins (optional ?status= filter) |
330	 * | GET | /plugins/ui-contributions | Get UI slots from ready plugins |
331	 * | GET | /plugins/:pluginId | Get single plugin by ID or key |
332	 * | POST | /plugins/install | Install from npm or local path |
333	 * | DELETE | /plugins/:pluginId | Uninstall (optional ?purge=true) |
334	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/enable | Enable a plugin |
335	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/disable | Disable a plugin |
336	 * | GET | /plugins/:pluginId/health | Run health diagnostics |
337	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/upgrade | Upgrade to newer version |
338	 * | GET | /plugins/:pluginId/jobs | List jobs for a plugin |
339	 * | GET | /plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/runs | List runs for a job |
340	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/trigger | Manually trigger a job |
341	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/webhooks/:endpointKey | Receive inbound webhook |
342	 * | GET | /plugins/tools | List all available plugin tools |
343	 * | GET | /plugins/tools?pluginId=... | List tools for a specific plugin |
344	 * | POST | /plugins/tools/execute | Execute a plugin tool |
345	 * | GET | /plugins/:pluginId/config | Get current plugin config |
346	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/config | Save (upsert) plugin config |
347	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/config/test | Test config via validateConfig RPC |
348	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/bridge/data | Proxy getData to plugin worker |
349	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/bridge/action | Proxy performAction to plugin worker |
350	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/data/:key | Proxy getData to plugin worker (key in URL) |
351	 * | POST | /plugins/:pluginId/actions/:key | Proxy performAction to plugin worker (key in URL) |
352	 * | GET | /plugins/:pluginId/bridge/stream/:channel | SSE stream from worker to UI |
353	 * | GET | /plugins/:pluginId/dashboard | Aggregated health dashboard data |
354	 *
355	 * **Route Ordering Note:** Static routes (like /ui-contributions, /tools) must be
356	 * registered before parameterized routes (like /:pluginId) to prevent Express from
357	 * matching them as a plugin ID.
358	 *
359	 * @param db - Database connection instance
360	 * @param jobDeps - Optional job scheduling dependencies
361	 * @param webhookDeps - Optional webhook ingestion dependencies
362	 * @param toolDeps - Optional tool dispatcher dependencies
363	 * @param bridgeDeps - Optional bridge proxy dependencies for getData/performAction
364	 * @returns Express router with plugin routes mounted
365	 */
366	export function pluginRoutes(
367	  db: Db,
368	  loader: ReturnType<typeof pluginLoader>,
369	  jobDeps?: PluginRouteJobDeps,
370	  webhookDeps?: PluginRouteWebhookDeps,
371	  toolDeps?: PluginRouteToolDeps,
372	  bridgeDeps?: PluginRouteBridgeDeps,
373	) {
374	  const router = Router();
375	  const registry = pluginRegistryService(db);
376	  const lifecycle = pluginLifecycleManager(db, {
377	    loader,
378	    workerManager: bridgeDeps?.workerManager ?? webhookDeps?.workerManager,
379	  });
380	  const issuesSvc = issueService(db);
381	
382	  // Storage is not needed by plugin handlers directly (bridge calls go to the
383	  // worker). Supply a sentinel that throws on access.
384	  const storageSentinel = new Proxy({} as StorageService, {
385	    get(_target, prop) {
386	      throw new Error(`plugin handler unexpectedly accessed storage.${String(prop)}`);
387	    },
388	  });
389	
390	  const adapterDeps = { db, storage: storageSentinel };
391	
392	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
393	  // Express-only helpers (operate on req/res directly — not migrated to Handler)
394	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
395	
396	  function matchScopedApiRoute(route: PluginApiRouteDeclaration, method: string, requestPath: string) {
397	    if (route.method !== method) return null;
398	    const normalize = (value: string) => value.replace(/\/+$/, "") || "/";
399	    const routeSegments = normalize(route.path).split("/").filter(Boolean);
400	    const requestSegments = normalize(requestPath).split("/").filter(Boolean);
401	    if (routeSegments.length !== requestSegments.length) return null;
402	    const params: Record<string, string> = {};
403	    for (let i = 0; i < routeSegments.length; i += 1) {
404	      const routeSegment = routeSegments[i]!;
405	      const requestSegment = requestSegments[i]!;
406	      if (routeSegment.startsWith(":")) {
407	        params[routeSegment.slice(1)] = decodeURIComponent(requestSegment);
408	        continue;
409	      }
410	      if (routeSegment !== requestSegment) return null;
411	    }
412	    return params;
413	  }
414	
415	  function sanitizePluginRequestHeaders(req: Request): Record<string, string> {
416	    const safeHeaderNames = new Set([
417	      "accept",
418	      "content-type",
419	      "user-agent",
420	      "x-paperclip-run-id",
421	      "x-request-id",
422	    ]);
423	    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
424	    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(req.headers)) {
425	      const lower = name.toLowerCase();
426	      if (!safeHeaderNames.has(lower)) continue;
427	      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
428	        headers[lower] = value.join(", ");
429	      } else if (typeof value === "string") {
430	        headers[lower] = value;
431	      }
432	    }
433	    return headers;
434	  }
435	
436	  function applyPluginScopedApiResponseHeaders(
437	    res: Response,
438	    headers: Record<string, string> | undefined,
439	  ): void {
440	    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(headers ?? {})) {
441	      const lower = name.toLowerCase();
442	      if (!PLUGIN_SCOPED_API_RESPONSE_HEADER_ALLOWLIST.has(lower)) continue;
443	      res.setHeader(lower, value);
444	    }
445	  }
446	
447	  function normalizeQuery(query: Request["query"]): Record<string, string | string[]> {
448	    const normalized: Record<string, string | string[]> = {};
449	    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query)) {
450	      if (typeof value === "string") {
451	        normalized[key] = value;
452	      } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
453	        normalized[key] = value.map((entry) => String(entry));
454	      }
455	    }
456	    return normalized;
457	  }

459	  async function resolveScopedApiCompanyId(
460	    route: PluginApiRouteDeclaration,
461	    params: Record<string, string>,
462	    req: Request,
463	  ) {
464	    const resolution = route.companyResolution;
465	    if (!resolution) {
466	      if (req.actor.type === "agent" && req.actor.companyId) return req.actor.companyId;
467	      return null;
468	    }
469	
470	    if (resolution.from === "body") {
471	      const body = req.body as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
472	      const companyId = body?.[resolution.key ?? ""];
473	      return typeof companyId === "string" ? companyId : null;
474	    }
475	
476	    if (resolution.from === "query") {
477	      const value = req.query[resolution.key ?? ""];
478	      return typeof value === "string" ? value : null;
479	    }
480	
481	    const issueId = params[resolution.param ?? ""];
482	    if (!issueId) return null;
483	    const issue = await issuesSvc.getById(issueId);
484	    return issue?.companyId ?? null;
485	  }
486	
487	  function assertScopedApiAuth(req: Request, route: PluginApiRouteDeclaration) {
488	    if (route.auth === "board") {
489	      assertBoard(req);
490	      return;
491	    }
492	    if (route.auth === "agent") {
493	      assertAuthenticated(req);
494	      if (req.actor.type !== "agent") throw forbidden("Agent access required");
495	      return;
496	    }
497	    if (route.auth === "webhook") {
498	      throw unprocessable("Webhook-scoped plugin API routes require a signature verifier and are not enabled");
499	    }
500	    assertAuthenticated(req);
501	    if (req.actor.type !== "board" && req.actor.type !== "agent") {
502	      throw forbidden("Board or agent access required");
503	    }
504	  }
505	
506	  async function enforceScopedApiCheckout(
507	    req: Request,
508	    route: PluginApiRouteDeclaration,
509	    params: Record<string, string>,
510	    companyId: string,
511	  ) {
512	    const policy = route.checkoutPolicy ?? "none";
513	    if (policy === "none" || req.actor.type !== "agent") return;
514	    const issueId = params.issueId;
515	    if (!issueId) {
516	      throw unprocessable("Checkout-protected plugin API routes require an issueId route parameter");
517	    }
518	    const issue = await issuesSvc.getById(issueId);
519	    if (!issue || issue.companyId !== companyId) {
520	      throw notFound("Issue not found");
521	    }
522	    if (policy === "required-for-agent-in-progress") {
523	      if (issue.status !== "in_progress" || issue.assigneeAgentId !== req.actor.agentId) return;
524	    }
525	    const runId = req.actor.runId?.trim();
526	    if (!runId) {
527	      throw unauthorized("Agent run id required");
528	    }
529	    if (!req.actor.agentId) {
530	      throw forbidden("Agent authentication required");
531	    }
532	    await issuesSvc.assertCheckoutOwner(issueId, req.actor.agentId, runId);
533	  }

535	  async function resolvePluginAuditCompanyIds(req: Request): Promise<string[]> {
536	    if (typeof (db as { select?: unknown }).select === "function") {
537	      const rows = await db
538	        .select({ id: companies.id })
539	        .from(companies);
540	      return rows.map((row) => row.id);
541	    }
542	
543	    if (req.actor.type === "agent" && req.actor.companyId) {
544	      return [req.actor.companyId];
545	    }
546	
547	    if (req.actor.type === "board") {
548	      return req.actor.companyIds ?? [];
549	    }
550	
551	    return [];
552	  }

578	  function assertPluginBridgeScope(req: Request, companyId: unknown): string | undefined {
579	    if (companyId === undefined || companyId === null) {
580	      assertInstanceAdmin(req);
581	      return undefined;
582	    }
583	    if (typeof companyId !== "string" || companyId.trim().length === 0) {
584	      throw badRequest('"companyId" must be a non-empty string when provided');
585	    }
586	    assertCompanyAccess(req, companyId);
587	    return companyId;

606	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
607	  // Bridge error mapping
608	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
609	
610	  interface PluginBridgeErrorResponse {
611	    code: PluginBridgeErrorCode;
612	    message: string;
613	    details?: unknown;
614	  }
615	
616	  function mapRpcErrorToBridgeError(err: unknown): PluginBridgeErrorResponse {
617	    if (err instanceof JsonRpcCallError) {
618	      switch (err.code) {
619	        case PLUGIN_RPC_ERROR_CODES.WORKER_UNAVAILABLE:
620	          return { code: "WORKER_UNAVAILABLE", message: err.message, details: err.data };
621	        case PLUGIN_RPC_ERROR_CODES.CAPABILITY_DENIED:
622	          return { code: "CAPABILITY_DENIED", message: err.message, details: err.data };
623	        case PLUGIN_RPC_ERROR_CODES.TIMEOUT:
624	          return { code: "TIMEOUT", message: err.message, details: err.data };
625	        case PLUGIN_RPC_ERROR_CODES.WORKER_ERROR:
626	          return { code: "WORKER_ERROR", message: err.message, details: err.data };
627	        default:
628	          return { code: "UNKNOWN", message: err.message, details: err.data };
629	      }
630	    }
631	
632	    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
633	
634	    if (message.includes("not running") || message.includes("not registered")) {
635	      return { code: "WORKER_UNAVAILABLE", message };
636	    }
637	
638	    return { code: "UNKNOWN", message };
639	  }

641	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
642	  // Tool scope validation
643	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
644	
645	  async function validateToolRunContextScope(runContext: ToolRunContext): Promise<string | null> {
646	    const [agent] = await db
647	      .select({ companyId: agents.companyId })
648	      .from(agents)
649	      .where(eq(agents.id, runContext.agentId))
650	      .limit(1);
651	    if (!agent || agent.companyId !== runContext.companyId) {
652	      return '"runContext.agentId" does not belong to "runContext.companyId"';
653	    }
654	
655	    const [run] = await db
656	      .select({ companyId: heartbeatRuns.companyId, agentId: heartbeatRuns.agentId })
657	      .from(heartbeatRuns)
658	      .where(eq(heartbeatRuns.id, runContext.runId))
659	      .limit(1);
660	    if (!run || run.companyId !== runContext.companyId) {
661	      return '"runContext.runId" does not belong to "runContext.companyId"';
662	    }
663	    if (run.agentId !== runContext.agentId) {
664	      return '"runContext.runId" does not belong to "runContext.agentId"';
665	    }
666	
667	    const [project] = await db
668	      .select({ companyId: projects.companyId })
669	      .from(projects)
670	      .where(eq(projects.id, runContext.projectId))
671	      .limit(1);
672	    if (!project || project.companyId !== runContext.companyId) {
673	      return '"runContext.projectId" does not belong to "runContext.companyId"';
674	    }
675	
676	    return null;
677	  }

760	  const executePluginTool: Handler = async (ctx) => {
761	    assertBoardOrgAccessCtx(ctx);
762	
763	    if (!toolDeps) {
764	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin tool dispatch is not enabled" }, { status: 501 });
765	    }
766	
767	    const body = await ctx.json<PluginToolExecuteRequest | undefined>();
768	    if (!body) {
769	      return Response.json({ error: "Request body is required" }, { status: 400 });
770	    }
771	
772	    const { tool, parameters, runContext } = body;
773	
774	    if (!tool || typeof tool !== "string") {
775	      return Response.json({ error: '"tool" is required and must be a string' }, { status: 400 });
776	    }
777	
778	    if (!runContext || typeof runContext !== "object") {
779	      return Response.json({ error: '"runContext" is required and must be an object' }, { status: 400 });
780	    }
781	
782	    if (!runContext.agentId || !runContext.runId || !runContext.companyId || !runContext.projectId) {
783	      return Response.json({
784	        error: '"runContext" must include agentId, runId, companyId, and projectId',
785	      }, { status: 400 });
786	    }
787	
788	    if (!ctx.actor) throw forbidden("Authentication required");
789	    const scopeError = await validateToolRunContextScope(runContext);
790	    if (scopeError) {
791	      return Response.json({ error: scopeError }, { status: 403 });
792	    }
793	
794	    const registeredTool = toolDeps.toolDispatcher.getTool(tool);
795	    if (!registeredTool) {
796	      return Response.json({ error: `Tool "${tool}" not found` }, { status: 404 });
797	    }
798	
799	    try {
800	      const result = await toolDeps.toolDispatcher.executeTool(
801	        tool,
802	        parameters ?? {},
803	        runContext,
804	      );
805	      return Response.json(result);
806	    } catch (err) {
807	      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
808	
809	      if (message.includes("not running") || message.includes("worker")) {
810	        return Response.json({ error: message }, { status: 502 });
811	      }
812	      return Response.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
813	    }
814	  };

816	  /**
817	   * POST /api/plugins/install
818	   */
819	  const installPlugin: Handler = async (ctx) => {
820	    // Instance-admin is enforced at the Express middleware layer before this handler.
821	    const body = await ctx.json<PluginInstallRequest>();
822	    const { packageName, version, isLocalPath } = body;
823	
824	    if (!packageName || typeof packageName !== "string") {
825	      return Response.json({ error: "packageName is required and must be a string" }, { status: 400 });
826	    }
827	
828	    if (version !== undefined && typeof version !== "string") {
829	      return Response.json({ error: "version must be a string if provided" }, { status: 400 });
830	    }
831	
832	    if (isLocalPath !== undefined && typeof isLocalPath !== "boolean") {
833	      return Response.json({ error: "isLocalPath must be a boolean if provided" }, { status: 400 });
834	    }
835	
836	    const trimmedPackage = packageName.trim();
837	    if (trimmedPackage.length === 0) {
838	      return Response.json({ error: "packageName cannot be empty" }, { status: 400 });
839	    }
840	
841	    if (!isLocalPath && /[<>:"|?*]/.test(trimmedPackage)) {
842	      return Response.json({ error: "packageName contains invalid characters" }, { status: 400 });
843	    }
844	
845	    try {
846	      const installOptions = isLocalPath
847	        ? { localPath: trimmedPackage }
848	        : { packageName: trimmedPackage, version: version?.trim() };
849	
850	      const discovered = await loader.installPlugin(installOptions);
851	
852	      if (!discovered.manifest) {
853	        return Response.json({ error: "Plugin installed but manifest is missing" }, { status: 500 });
854	      }
855	
856	      const existingPlugin = await registry.getByKey(discovered.manifest.id);
857	      if (existingPlugin) {
858	        await lifecycle.load(existingPlugin.id);
859	        const updated = await registry.getById(existingPlugin.id);
860	        // logPluginMutationActivity needs an Express Request for the richer actor
861	        // shape; delegate to caller via the Express middleware layer.
862	        publishGlobalLiveEvent({ type: "plugin.ui.updated", payload: { pluginId: existingPlugin.id, action: "installed" } });
863	        return Response.json(updated);
864	      }
865	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin installed but not found in registry" }, { status: 500 });
866	    } catch (err) {
867	      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
868	      return Response.json({ error: message }, { status: 400 });
869	    }
870	  };

1179	  /**
1180	   * GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/health
1181	   */
1182	  const getPluginHealth: Handler = async (ctx) => {
1183	    assertBoardOrgAccessCtx(ctx);
1184	    const pluginId = ctx.param("pluginId");
1185	    if (!pluginId) return Response.json({ error: "Missing pluginId" }, { status: 400 });
1186	
1187	    const plugin = await resolvePlugin(registry, pluginId);
1188	    if (!plugin) {
1189	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin not found" }, { status: 404 });
1190	    }
1191	
1192	    const checks: PluginHealthCheckResult["checks"] = [];
1193	
1194	    checks.push({ name: "registry", passed: true, message: "Plugin found in registry" });
1195	
1196	    const hasValidManifest = Boolean(plugin.manifestJson?.id);
1197	    checks.push({
1198	      name: "manifest",
1199	      passed: hasValidManifest,
1200	      message: hasValidManifest ? "Manifest is valid" : "Manifest is invalid or missing",
1201	    });
1202	
1203	    const isHealthy = plugin.status === "ready";
1204	    checks.push({ name: "status", passed: isHealthy, message: `Current status: ${plugin.status}` });
1205	
1206	    const hasNoError = !plugin.lastError;
1207	    if (!hasNoError) {
1208	      checks.push({ name: "error_state", passed: false, message: plugin.lastError ?? undefined });
1209	    }
1210	
1211	    const result: PluginHealthCheckResult = {
1212	      pluginId: plugin.id,
1213	      status: plugin.status,
1214	      healthy: isHealthy && hasValidManifest && hasNoError,
1215	      checks,
1216	      lastError: plugin.lastError ?? undefined,
1217	    };
1218	
1219	    return Response.json(result);
1220	  };

1229

1231	    if (!plugin) {
1232	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin not found" }, { status: 404 });
1233	    }
1234	
1235	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(ctx.query("limit") ?? "25", 10) || 25, 1), 500);
1236	    const level = ctx.query("level");
1237	    const since = ctx.query("since");
1238	
1239	    const conditions = [eq(pluginLogs.pluginId, plugin.id)];
1240	    if (level) {
1241	      conditions.push(eq(pluginLogs.level, level));
1242	    }
1243	    if (since) {
1244	      const sinceDate = new Date(since);
1245	      if (!isNaN(sinceDate.getTime())) {
1246	        conditions.push(gte(pluginLogs.createdAt, sinceDate));
1247	      }
1248	    }
1249	
1250	    const rows = await db
1251	      .select()
1252	      .from(pluginLogs)
1253	      .where(and(...conditions))
1254	      .orderBy(desc(pluginLogs.createdAt))
1255	      .limit(limit);
1256	
1257	    return Response.json(rows);
1258	  };

1302	  /**
1303	   * POST /api/plugins/:pluginId/config
1304	   */
1305	  const savePluginConfig: Handler = async (ctx) => {
1306	    // Instance-admin enforced at Express layer.
1307	    const pluginId = ctx.param("pluginId");
1308	    if (!pluginId) return Response.json({ error: "Missing pluginId" }, { status: 400 });
1309	
1310	    const plugin = await resolvePlugin(registry, pluginId);
1311	    if (!plugin) {
1312	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin not found" }, { status: 404 });
1313	    }
1314	
1315	    const body = await ctx.json<{ configJson?: Record<string, unknown> } | undefined>();
1316	    if (!body?.configJson || typeof body.configJson !== "object") {
1317	      return Response.json({ error: '"configJson" is required and must be an object' }, { status: 400 });
1318	    }
1319	
1320	    // devUiUrl strip: only instance admins may set it. The Express layer
1321	    // enforces instance-admin before this handler runs, so if we reach here
1322	    // the caller is an instance admin and devUiUrl is allowed.
1323	
1324	    const schema = plugin.manifestJson?.instanceConfigSchema;
1325	    if (schema && Object.keys(schema).length > 0) {
1326	      const validation = validateInstanceConfig(body.configJson, schema);
1327	      if (!validation.valid) {
1328	        return Response.json({
1329	          error: "Configuration does not match the plugin's instanceConfigSchema",
1330	          fieldErrors: validation.errors,
1331	        }, { status: 400 });
1332	      }
1333	    }
1334	
1335	    try {
1336	      const result = await registry.upsertConfig(plugin.id, {
1337	        configJson: body.configJson,
1338	      });
1339	
1340	      if (bridgeDeps?.workerManager.isRunning(plugin.id)) {
1341	        try {
1342	          await bridgeDeps.workerManager.call(
1343	            plugin.id,
1344	            "configChanged",
1345	            { config: body.configJson },
1346	          );
1347	        } catch (rpcErr) {
1348	          if (
1349	            rpcErr instanceof JsonRpcCallError &&
1350	            rpcErr.code === PLUGIN_RPC_ERROR_CODES.METHOD_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
1351	          ) {
1352	            try {
1353	              await lifecycle.restartWorker(plugin.id);
1354	            } catch {
1355	              // Restart failure is non-fatal for the config save response.
1356	            }
1357	          }
1358	        }
1359	      }
1360	
1361	      return Response.json(result);
1362	    } catch (err) {
1363	      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
1364	      return Response.json({ error: message }, { status: 400 });
1365	    }
1366	  };

1368	  /**
1369	   * POST /api/plugins/:pluginId/config/test
1370	   */
1371	  const testPluginConfig: Handler = async (ctx) => {
1372	    assertBoardOrgAccessCtx(ctx);
1373	
1374	    if (!bridgeDeps) {
1375	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin bridge is not enabled" }, { status: 501 });
1376	    }
1377	
1378	    const pluginId = ctx.param("pluginId");
1379	    if (!pluginId) return Response.json({ error: "Missing pluginId" }, { status: 400 });
1380	
1381	    const plugin = await resolvePlugin(registry, pluginId);
1382	    if (!plugin) {
1383	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin not found" }, { status: 404 });
1384	    }
1385	
1386	    if (plugin.status !== "ready") {
1387	      return Response.json({ error: `Plugin is not ready (current status: ${plugin.status})` }, { status: 400 });
1388	    }
1389	
1390	    const body = await ctx.json<{ configJson?: Record<string, unknown> } | undefined>();
1391	    if (!body?.configJson || typeof body.configJson !== "object") {
1392	      return Response.json({ error: '"configJson" is required and must be an object' }, { status: 400 });
1393	    }
1394	
1395	    const schema = plugin.manifestJson?.instanceConfigSchema;
1396	    if (schema && Object.keys(schema).length > 0) {
1397	      const validation = validateInstanceConfig(body.configJson, schema);
1398	      if (!validation.valid) {
1399	        return Response.json({
1400	          error: "Configuration does not match the plugin's instanceConfigSchema",
1401	          fieldErrors: validation.errors,
1402	        }, { status: 400 });
1403	      }
1404	    }
1405	
1406	    try {
1407	      const result = await bridgeDeps.workerManager.call(
1408	        plugin.id,
1409	        "validateConfig",
1410	        { config: body.configJson },
1411	      );
1412	
1413	      if (result.ok) {
1414	        const warningText = result.warnings?.length
1415	          ? `Warnings: ${result.warnings.join("; ")}`
1416	          : undefined;
1417	        return Response.json({ valid: true, message: warningText });
1418	      }
1419	      const errorText = result.errors?.length
1420	        ? result.errors.join("; ")
1421	        : "Configuration validation failed.";
1422	      return Response.json({ valid: false, message: errorText });
1423	    } catch (err) {
1424	      if (
1425	        err instanceof JsonRpcCallError &&
1426	        err.code === PLUGIN_RPC_ERROR_CODES.METHOD_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
1427	      ) {
1428	        return Response.json({
1429	          valid: false,
1430	          supported: false,
1431	          message: "This plugin does not support configuration testing.",
1432	        });
1433	      }
1434	
1435	      const bridgeError = mapRpcErrorToBridgeError(err);
1436	      return Response.json(bridgeError, { status: 502 });
1437	    }
1438	  };

1547	  /**
1548	   * POST /api/plugins/:pluginId/webhooks/:endpointKey
1549	   *
1550	   * NOTE: This route does NOT require board authentication — webhook endpoints
1551	   * must be publicly accessible for external callers.
1552	   */
1553	  const receiveWebhook: Handler = async (ctx) => {
1554	    if (!webhookDeps) {
1555	      return Response.json({ error: "Webhook ingestion is not enabled" }, { status: 501 });
1556	    }
1557	
1558	    const pluginId = ctx.param("pluginId");
1559	    const endpointKey = ctx.param("endpointKey");
1560	    if (!pluginId) return Response.json({ error: "Missing pluginId" }, { status: 400 });
1561	    if (!endpointKey) return Response.json({ error: "Missing endpointKey" }, { status: 400 });
1562	
1563	    const plugin = await resolvePlugin(registry, pluginId);
1564	    if (!plugin) {
1565	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin not found" }, { status: 404 });
1566	    }
1567	
1568	    if (plugin.status !== "ready") {
1569	      return Response.json({
1570	        error: `Plugin is not ready (current status: ${plugin.status})`,
1571	      }, { status: 400 });
1572	    }
1573	
1574	    const manifest = plugin.manifestJson;
1575	    if (!manifest) {
1576	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin manifest is missing" }, { status: 400 });
1577	    }
1578	
1579	    const capabilities = manifest.capabilities ?? [];
1580	    if (!capabilities.includes("webhooks.receive")) {
1581	      return Response.json({
1582	        error: "Plugin does not have the webhooks.receive capability",
1583	      }, { status: 400 });
1584	    }
1585	
1586	    const declaredWebhooks = manifest.webhooks ?? [];
1587	    const webhookDecl = declaredWebhooks.find((w) => w.endpointKey === endpointKey);
1588	    if (!webhookDecl) {
1589	      return Response.json({
1590	        error: `Webhook endpoint '${endpointKey}' is not declared by this plugin`,
1591	      }, { status: 404 });
1592	    }
1593	
1594	    const requestId = randomUUID();
1595	    const rawHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};
1596	    ctx.headers.forEach((value, name) => {
1597	      rawHeaders[name] = value;
1598	    });
1599	
1600	    // The rawBody stash from express.json() verify callback is not available in
1601	    // the transport-agnostic ctx. Fall back to re-reading via ctx.text().
1602	    const rawBody = await ctx.text();
1603	    const parsedBody = await ctx.json<unknown>().catch(() => null);
1604	    const payload = (parsedBody as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
1605	
1606	    const startedAt = new Date();
1607	    const [delivery] = await db
1608	      .insert(pluginWebhookDeliveries)
1609	      .values({
1610	        pluginId: plugin.id,
1611	        webhookKey: endpointKey,
1612	        status: "pending",
1613	        payload,
1614	        headers: rawHeaders,
1615	        startedAt,
1616	      })
1617	      .returning({ id: pluginWebhookDeliveries.id });
1618	
1619	    try {
1620	      await webhookDeps.workerManager.call(plugin.id, "handleWebhook", {
1621	        endpointKey,
1622	        headers: rawHeaders,
1623	        rawBody,
1624	        parsedBody,
1625	        requestId,
1626	      });
1627	
1628	      const finishedAt = new Date();
1629	      const durationMs = finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime();
1630	      await db
1631	        .update(pluginWebhookDeliveries)
1632	        .set({ status: "success", durationMs, finishedAt })
1633	        .where(eq(pluginWebhookDeliveries.id, delivery.id));
1634	
1635	      return Response.json({ deliveryId: delivery.id, status: "success" }, { status: 200 });
1636	    } catch (err) {
1637	      const finishedAt = new Date();
1638	      const durationMs = finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime();
1639	      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
1640	
1641	      await db
1642	        .update(pluginWebhookDeliveries)
1643	        .set({ status: "failed", durationMs, error: errorMessage, finishedAt })
1644	        .where(eq(pluginWebhookDeliveries.id, delivery.id));
1645	
1646	      return Response.json({ deliveryId: delivery.id, status: "failed", error: errorMessage }, { status: 502 });
1647	    }
1648	  };

1650	  /**
1651	   * GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/dashboard
1652	   */
1653	  const getPluginDashboard: Handler = async (ctx) => {
1654	    assertBoardOrgAccessCtx(ctx);
1655	    const pluginId = ctx.param("pluginId");
1656	    if (!pluginId) return Response.json({ error: "Missing pluginId" }, { status: 400 });
1657	
1658	    const plugin = await resolvePlugin(registry, pluginId);
1659	    if (!plugin) {
1660	      return Response.json({ error: "Plugin not found" }, { status: 404 });
1661	    }
1662	
1663	    let worker: {
1664	      status: string;
1665	      pid: number | null;
1666	      uptime: number | null;
1667	      consecutiveCrashes: number;
1668	      totalCrashes: number;
1669	      pendingRequests: number;
1670	      lastCrashAt: number | null;
1671	      nextRestartAt: number | null;
1672	    } | null = null;
1673	
1674	    const wm = bridgeDeps?.workerManager ?? webhookDeps?.workerManager ?? null;
1675	    if (wm) {
1676	      const handle = wm.getWorker(plugin.id);
1677	      if (handle) {
1678	        const diag = handle.diagnostics();
1679	        worker = {
1680	          status: diag.status,
1681	          pid: diag.pid,
1682	          uptime: diag.uptime,
1683	          consecutiveCrashes: diag.consecutiveCrashes,
1684	          totalCrashes: diag.totalCrashes,
1685	          pendingRequests: diag.pendingRequests,
1686	          lastCrashAt: diag.lastCrashAt,
1687	          nextRestartAt: diag.nextRestartAt,
1688	        };
1689	      }
1690	    }
1691	
1692	    let recentJobRuns: Array<{
1693	      id: string;
1694	      jobId: string;
1695	      jobKey?: string;
1696	      trigger: string;
1697	      status: string;
1698	      durationMs: number | null;
1699	      error: string | null;
1700	      startedAt: string | null;
1701	      finishedAt: string | null;
1702	      createdAt: string;
1703	    }> = [];
1704	
1705	    if (jobDeps) {
1706	      try {
1707	        const runs = await jobDeps.jobStore.listRunsByPlugin(plugin.id, undefined, 10);
1708	        const jobs = await jobDeps.jobStore.listJobs(plugin.id);
1709	        const jobKeyMap = new Map(jobs.map((j) => [j.id, j.jobKey]));
1710	
1711	        recentJobRuns = runs
1712	          .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime())
1713	          .map((r) => ({
1714	            id: r.id,
1715	            jobId: r.jobId,
1716	            jobKey: jobKeyMap.get(r.jobId) ?? undefined,
1717	            trigger: r.trigger,
1718	            status: r.status,
1719	            durationMs: r.durationMs,
1720	            error: r.error,
1721	            startedAt: r.startedAt ? new Date(r.startedAt).toISOString() : null,
1722	            finishedAt: r.finishedAt ? new Date(r.finishedAt).toISOString() : null,
1723	            createdAt: new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString(),
1724	          }));
1725	      } catch {
1726	        // Job data unavailable — leave empty
1727	      }
1728	    }
1729	
1730	    let recentWebhookDeliveries: Array<{
1731	      id: string;
1732	      webhookKey: string;
1733	      status: string;
1734	      durationMs: number | null;
1735	      error: string | null;
1736	      startedAt: string | null;
1737	      finishedAt: string | null;
1738	      createdAt: string;
1739	    }> = [];
1740	
1741	    try {
1742	      const deliveries = await db
1743	        .select({
1744	          id: pluginWebhookDeliveries.id,
1745	          webhookKey: pluginWebhookDeliveries.webhookKey,
1746	          status: pluginWebhookDeliveries.status,
1747	          durationMs: pluginWebhookDeliveries.durationMs,
1748	          error: pluginWebhookDeliveries.error,
1749	          startedAt: pluginWebhookDeliveries.startedAt,
1750	          finishedAt: pluginWebhookDeliveries.finishedAt,
1751	          createdAt: pluginWebhookDeliveries.createdAt,
1752	        })
1753	        .from(pluginWebhookDeliveries)
1754	        .where(eq(pluginWebhookDeliveries.pluginId, plugin.id))
1755	        .orderBy(desc(pluginWebhookDeliveries.createdAt))
1756	        .limit(10);
1757	
1758	      recentWebhookDeliveries = deliveries.map((d) => ({
1759	        id: d.id,
1760	        webhookKey: d.webhookKey,
1761	        status: d.status,
1762	        durationMs: d.durationMs,
1763	        error: d.error,
1764	        startedAt: d.startedAt ? d.startedAt.toISOString() : null,
1765	        finishedAt: d.finishedAt ? d.finishedAt.toISOString() : null,
1766	        createdAt: d.createdAt.toISOString(),
1767	      }));
1768	    } catch {
1769	      // Webhook data unavailable — leave empty
1770	    }
1771	
1772	    const checks: PluginHealthCheckResult["checks"] = [];
1773	
1774	    checks.push({ name: "registry", passed: true, message: "Plugin found in registry" });
1775	
1776	    const hasValidManifest = Boolean(plugin.manifestJson?.id);
1777	    checks.push({
1778	      name: "manifest",
1779	      passed: hasValidManifest,
1780	      message: hasValidManifest ? "Manifest is valid" : "Manifest is invalid or missing",
1781	    });
1782	
1783	    const isHealthy = plugin.status === "ready";
1784	    checks.push({ name: "status", passed: isHealthy, message: `Current status: ${plugin.status}` });
1785	
1786	    const hasNoError = !plugin.lastError;
1787	    if (!hasNoError) {
1788	      checks.push({ name: "error_state", passed: false, message: plugin.lastError ?? undefined });
1789	    }
1790	
1791	    const health: PluginHealthCheckResult = {
1792	      pluginId: plugin.id,
1793	      status: plugin.status,
1794	      healthy: isHealthy && hasValidManifest && hasNoError,
1795	      checks,
1796	      lastError: plugin.lastError ?? undefined,
1797	    };
1798	
1799	    return Response.json({
1800	      pluginId: plugin.id,
1801	      worker,
1802	      recentJobRuns,
1803	      recentWebhookDeliveries,
1804	      health,
1805	      checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
1806	    });
1807	  };

1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user asked to migrate the Paperclip project (a fork of `paperclipai/paperclip` — an AI-agent company control plane) to be hosted exclusively on Cloudflare with a one-click "Deploy to Cloudflare" button. Goals: pay-as-you-go billing, horizontal scaling via Cloudflare Workers/DOs/Workflows, minimal idle cost (~$5/mo). The user explicitly confirmed they are fine with a massive rewrite, want everything implemented (not just planned), and are working in their own fork so all changes can go directly to the `feat/cloudflare-deployment` branch.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Cloudflare Workers** — serverless compute, Hono framework as Express replacement
   - **Durable Objects (DOs)** — per-task/per-agent stateful compute with WebSocket Hibernation API; sleep when idle
   - **Cloudflare Workflows** — durable multi-step orchestration for heartbeat/agent runs
   - **D1 / Hyperdrive** — Phase 1 uses Hyperdrive → Neon Postgres (no schema port); Phase 2 is D1
   - **R2** — object storage for artifacts, skills, logs (no egress fees)
   - **KV** — sessions and hot config
   - **Queues** — background fanout, plugin job dispatch
   - **Deployment platform as orthogonal axis** — `node | cloudflare`, separate from auth mode (`local_trusted | authenticated`)
   - **Sidecar model** — Node server acts as sidecar for plugin process execution, workspace provisioning

   - `RequestCtx` interface: `method`, `url`, `headers`, `json<T>()`, `text()`, `param(name)`, `query(name)`, `actor`, `db`, `storage`

   - `expressHandler(handler, deps)` wraps a `Handler` as Express `RequestHandler` — populates full `RequestCtx` from Express `req`
   - `AdapterDeps = { db: Db; storage: StorageService }` — required even when handler doesn't use storage (sentinel `null as never` used)
   - `AuthzReq` — structural interface satisfied by both `Express.Request` and `RequestCtx`; authz helpers (`assertBoard`, `assertCompanyAccess`, `getActorInfo`, etc.) work with both

/**
 * Main Cloudflare Worker entry point for the Paperclip API.
 *
 * This file:
 *   1. Creates a Hono app and mounts route definitions.
 *   2. Implements the first-run setup gate (redirects to /setup until KV flag is set).
 *   3. Handles Cloudflare Queues message batches (plugin job fanout).
 *   4. Handles Cloudflare Cron Triggers (heartbeat sweep, budget checks, DB backup).
 *   5. Re-exports all Durable Object and Workflow classes so Wrangler can
 *      register them — they must be named exports from the Worker's main module.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import { createSetupApp } from "./setup.js";
import { bootCloudflare } from "../boot.js";
import { SidecarClient } from "../sidecar-client.js";
import { CfCompanySkillsService } from "../services/cf-company-skills.js";
import { CfAgentInstructionsService } from "../services/cf-agent-instructions.js";

// createHyperdriveDb is imported here to make it available for use when the
// HTTP adapter migration lands (PR #6/#7). Remove the comment and use it in
// the fetch handler once route modules are mounted.
// import { createHyperdriveDb } from "../db/hyperdrive.js";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Env — Cloudflare bindings injected at runtime
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface Env {
  // Databases
  HYPERDRIVE: { connectionString: string };

  // Object storage
  PAPERCLIP_STORAGE: R2Bucket;

  // KV — setup flags, hot config, session cache
  PAPERCLIP_KV: KVNamespace;

  // Durable Object namespaces
  TASK_DO: DurableObjectNamespace;
  AGENT_RUN_DO: DurableObjectNamespace;
  SCHEDULER_DO: DurableObjectNamespace;

  // Queues
  PAPERCLIP_QUEUE: Queue;

  // Workflows
  HEARTBEAT_WORKFLOW: Workflow;
  PLUGIN_DISPATCH_WORKFLOW: Workflow;

  // Vars (set in wrangler.toml [vars])
  DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM: string;
  DEPLOYMENT_MODE: string;
  DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE: string;

  // Secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`)
  // MASTER_ENCRYPTION_KEY: string  — encrypts all other secrets stored in DB
  // SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL: string
  // SANDBOX_BRIDGE_API_KEY: string

  // Sidecar — the Node server running alongside the Workers deployment.
  // Workers delegate filesystem, child-process, and plugin-loading operations
  // to this process over HTTP (see SidecarClient).
  SIDECAR_URL: string;
  SIDECAR_API_KEY: string;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Hono app
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

// Health check — always reachable, no auth, no setup gate
app.get("/api/health", (c) =>
  c.json({
    status: "ok",
    platform: c.env.DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM ?? "cloudflare",
    mode: c.env.DEPLOYMENT_MODE ?? "authenticated",
    ts: new Date().toISOString(),
  }),
);

// First-run setup gate — redirect to /setup until SETUP_COMPLETED is "true"
app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
  // Allow the setup routes and health check through unconditionally
  if (c.req.path === "/api/health" || c.req.path.startsWith("/setup")) {
    return next();
  }

  const setupCompleted = await c.env.PAPERCLIP_KV.get("SETUP_COMPLETED");
  if (setupCompleted !== "true") {
    return c.redirect("/setup");
  }

  return next();
});

// Delegate /setup/* to the setup sub-app.
// createSetupApp returns a Hono instance whose routes are relative to "/",
// so we strip the "/setup" prefix before forwarding.
app.all("/setup/*", async (c) => {
  const setupSub = createSetupApp(c.env);
  const url = new URL(c.req.url);
  // Strip leading "/setup" so routes inside the sub-app match against "/"
  url.pathname = url.pathname.replace(/^\/setup/, "") || "/";
  const rewritten = new Request(url.toString(), c.req.raw);
  return setupSub.fetch(rewritten);
});

// Exact "/setup" (no trailing slash) — forward as "/"
app.all("/setup", async (c) => {
  const setupSub = createSetupApp(c.env);
  const url = new URL(c.req.url);
  url.pathname = "/";
  const rewritten = new Request(url.toString(), c.req.raw);
  return setupSub.fetch(rewritten);
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// API routes
// TODO: mount migrated route modules here once the HTTP adapter
// migration (PR #6/#7) is complete. Pattern:
//
//   import { mountRoutes } from "../http/hono-adapter.js";
//   import { companyRoutes } from "../../../server/src/routes/companies.js";
//   mountRoutes(app, companyRoutes, { db, storage, resolveActor });
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Placeholder API fallthrough for any unmounted routes
app.all("/api/*", (c) => c.json({ error: "API route not yet mounted in CF Worker" }, 501));

// Catch-all for non-API requests — serve the Pages SPA (handled by Cloudflare Pages
// when the Worker is linked to a Pages project; this handler is only reached in
// local `wrangler dev` mode).
app.all("*", (c) =>
  c.html(
    `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>Paperclip</title></head>
<body>
  <p>Loading Paperclip UI... If this persists, the Pages build may not be deployed yet.</p>
</body></html>`,
  ),
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Default export — Workers fetch handler
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<Response> {
    // Boot the Cloudflare implementations on first request
    // (idempotent — registerStorageProvider uses a Map, safe to call multiple times)
    bootCloudflare(env);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // CF service layer — instantiated per-request (Workers are stateless).
    //
    // SidecarClient delegates Node-only operations (filesystem, child processes,
    // plugin loading) to the Paperclip Node server running alongside this Worker.
    //
    // CfCompanySkillsService stores skill file content in R2 under the key
    // pattern `skills/{companyId}/{skillId}/{relativePath}` and falls back to
    // the sidecar for local_path / catalog source types.
    //
    // CfAgentInstructionsService stores per-agent Markdown instruction files in
    // R2 under `instructions/{companyId}/{agentId}/{filename}`.
    //
    // TODO(PR #6/#7): pass these instances into the Hono context (via app.use)
    // or directly into route handler factories once route modules are mounted:
    //
    //   app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
    //     c.set("sidecar", sidecar);
    //     c.set("skills", skillsService);
    //     c.set("instructions", instructionsService);
    //     return next();
    //   });
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const sidecar = new SidecarClient({
      baseUrl: env.SIDECAR_URL,
      apiKey: env.SIDECAR_API_KEY,
    });
    const skillsService = new CfCompanySkillsService(env.PAPERCLIP_STORAGE, sidecar);
    const instructionsService = new CfAgentInstructionsService(env.PAPERCLIP_STORAGE);

    // Suppress unused-variable warnings until routes are mounted.
    void skillsService;
    void instructionsService;

    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Queues consumer — processes plugin job dispatch messages
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async queue(batch: MessageBatch<unknown>, env: Env): Promise<void> {
    for (const message of batch.messages) {
      const body = message.body as Record<string, unknown>;
      const type = body?.type as string | undefined;

      if (type === "plugin_job_dispatch") {
        const pluginJobId = body.pluginJobId as string;
        const pluginSlug = body.pluginSlug as string;
        const companyId = body.companyId as string;
        const executorMode = (body.executorMode as "sandbox_bridge" | "container") ?? "sandbox_bridge";

        try {
          await env.PLUGIN_DISPATCH_WORKFLOW.create({
            // Use the job ID as the Workflow instance ID for deduplication
            id: `plugin-job-${pluginJobId}`,
            params: { pluginJobId, pluginSlug, companyId, executorMode },
          });
          message.ack();
        } catch (err) {
          // Let the queue retry this message
          console.error(
            `[Queue] Failed to start PluginDispatchWorkflow for job ${pluginJobId}: ${
              err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
            }`,
          );
          message.retry();
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (type === "heartbeat_dispatch") {
        const agentId = body.agentId as string;
        const companyId = body.companyId as string;
        const runId = body.runId as string;
        const taskId = body.taskId as string | undefined;

        try {
          await env.HEARTBEAT_WORKFLOW.create({
            id: `heartbeat-${runId}`,
            params: { agentId, companyId, runId, taskId },
          });
          message.ack();
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(
            `[Queue] Failed to start HeartbeatWorkflow for run ${runId}: ${
              err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
            }`,
          );
          message.retry();
        }
        continue;
      }

      // Unknown message type — ack to avoid infinite retries
      console.warn(`[Queue] Unknown message type: ${type}`);
      message.ack();
    }
  },

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Cron Triggers — heartbeat sweep, budget checks, DB backup
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  async scheduled(event: ScheduledEvent, env: Env, _ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<void> {
    const cron = event.cron;
    console.log(`[Cron] Firing cron: ${cron}`);

    // TODO: replace with calls to the scheduler DO or direct internal API
    // endpoints once the HTTP adapter migration lands.
    if (cron === "*/5 * * * *") {
      // Heartbeat sweep — find agents that are due and enqueue heartbeat jobs
      // TODO: implement by querying the DB for due agents and posting to PAPERCLIP_QUEUE
      console.log("[Cron] Heartbeat sweep — not yet implemented");
    } else if (cron === "0 * * * *") {
      // Budget threshold check
      // TODO: implement by calling the internal budget service endpoint
      console.log("[Cron] Budget check — not yet implemented");
    } else if (cron === "0 3 * * *") {
      // Daily DB backup to R2
      // TODO: implement by triggering a Workflow that dumps Postgres to R2
      console.log("[Cron] DB backup — not yet implemented");
    }
  },
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Named Durable Object + Workflow exports
//
// Wrangler requires that DO classes and Workflow classes be named exports from
// the Worker's main module (the file pointed to by `main` in wrangler.toml).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Db } from "@paperclipai/db";

/**
 * Local copies of the HTTP handler types from `server/src/http/types.ts`.
 *
 * We duplicate rather than import because the server package uses Node-only
 * modules (`node:stream`, etc.) and cannot be bundled into a Worker. These
 * shapes must remain structurally identical to the upstream definitions.
 * When upstream types change, update these in lock-step.
 *
 * TODO: extract `server/src/http/types.ts` into a separate `@paperclipai/http`
 * package with zero Node dependencies so both the server and CF Worker can
 * import it directly (tracked in PR #6).
 */
export interface ActorContext {
  type: "board" | "agent";
  userId?: string;
  agentId?: string;
  companyId?: string;
}

export interface RequestCtx {
  method: string;
  url: URL;
  headers: Headers;
  json<T = unknown>(): Promise<T>;
  text(): Promise<string>;
  param(name: string): string | undefined;
  query(name: string): string | undefined;
  actor: ActorContext | null;
  db: Db;
  storage: StorageServiceLike;
}

export type Handler = (ctx: RequestCtx) => Promise<Response>;

export interface RouteDefinition {
  method: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";
  /** Express/Hono-style path, e.g. `/api/companies/:companyId`. */
  path: string;
  handler: Handler;
}

/**
 * Minimal shape of the storage service dependency.
 * We use a structural alias to avoid importing the server's Node-typed
 * `StorageService` directly.
 */
export interface StorageServiceLike {
  provider: string;
  putFile(input: unknown): Promise<unknown>;
  getObject(companyId: string, objectKey: string): Promise<unknown>;
  headObject(companyId: string, objectKey: string): Promise<unknown>;
  deleteObject(companyId: string, objectKey: string): Promise<void>;
}

export interface MountRoutesOptions {
  db: Db;
  storage: StorageServiceLike;
  /**
   * Optional middleware that populates `ctx.actor` from the request.
   * Called before the route handler for every matched route.
   *
   * Return `null` to treat the request as unauthenticated.
   * Throw or return a `Response` to short-circuit with an error.
   */
  resolveActor?: (request: Request) => Promise<ActorContext | null>;
}

/**
 * Mounts an array of `RouteDefinition` objects onto a Hono app.
 *
 * Each route definition is a transport-agnostic handler (from the
 * `server/src/http/types.ts` seam). This function bridges from the Hono
 * request context to the `RequestCtx` shape those handlers expect.
 *
 * Usage:
 * ```ts
 * import { Hono } from "hono";
 * import { mountRoutes } from "./hono-adapter.js";
 * import { myRoutes } from "../../server/src/routes/my-routes.js";
 *
 * const app = new Hono();
 * mountRoutes(app, myRoutes, { db, storage });
 * ```
 */
export function mountRoutes(
  app: Hono,
  routes: RouteDefinition[],
  options: MountRoutesOptions,
): void {
  const { db, storage, resolveActor } = options;

  for (const route of routes) {
    const method = route.method.toLowerCase() as "get" | "post" | "put" | "patch" | "delete";

    app[method](route.path, async (c) => {
      // Resolve actor from request (auth middleware equivalent)
      const actor = resolveActor ? await resolveActor(c.req.raw) : null;

      const ctx: RequestCtx = {
        method: c.req.method,
        url: new URL(c.req.url),
        headers: new Headers(c.req.raw.headers),

        async json<T>(): Promise<T> {
          return c.req.json<T>();
        },

        async text(): Promise<string> {
          return c.req.text();
        },

        param(name: string): string | undefined {
          return c.req.param(name);
        },

        query(name: string): string | undefined {
          return c.req.query(name);
        },

        actor,
        db,
        storage,
      };

      try {
        return await route.handler(ctx);
      } catch (err) {
        // Unhandled errors become 500s. In production, Cloudflare's Worker
        // error logging captures the stack trace.
        console.error(
          `[HonoAdapter] Unhandled error in ${route.method} ${route.path}: ${
            err instanceof Error ? err.stack ?? err.message : String(err)
          }`,
        );
        return c.json({ error: "Internal Server Error" }, 500);
      }
    });
  }
}

import { WorkflowEntrypoint, type WorkflowStep, type WorkflowEvent } from "cloudflare:workers";

/**
 * Parameters passed when triggering the HeartbeatWorkflow.
 */
export interface HeartbeatParams {
  /** The agent whose heartbeat is being executed. */
  agentId: string;
  /** Company the agent belongs to (used for scoped DB queries). */
  companyId: string;
  /** Unique identifier for this specific heartbeat run. */
  runId: string;
  /**
   * Optional task (issue) the agent is currently working on.
   * May be absent if the agent has no active checkout.
   */
  taskId?: string;
}

/**
 * Env bindings required by the HeartbeatWorkflow.
 * Keep in sync with `src/worker/api.ts#Env`.
 */
interface Env {
  AGENT_RUN_DO: DurableObjectNamespace;
  TASK_DO: DurableObjectNamespace;
  HYPERDRIVE: { connectionString: string };
  PAPERCLIP_KV: KVNamespace;
  // TODO: add SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL and SANDBOX_BRIDGE_API_KEY secrets
}

/**
 * HeartbeatWorkflow — Cloudflare Workflow that executes one agent heartbeat.
 *
 * A heartbeat is the fundamental unit of agent work in Paperclip: the agent
 * is woken up, runs an LLM turn (potentially using tools), and records the
 * outcome. The Workflow wraps this in durable, checkpointed steps so that a
 * Worker crash or timeout does not lose progress.
 *
 * Steps:
 *   1. init-run      — Create the AgentRunDO record; mark run as "running".
 *   2. execute       — Call the sandbox bridge to run the actual heartbeat.
 *                      Retries up to 2 times with a 5-second delay on failure.
 *   3. record-result — Update the AgentRunDO with the final outcome; notify
 *                      the TaskDO so connected UIs receive a state update.
 *
 * The Workflow is triggered by the SchedulerDO alarm handler or the
 * `POST /api/agents/:agentId/wakeup` endpoint.
 *
 * Idempotency: `runId` is unique per invocation. Cloudflare Workflows
 * guarantee each step runs at most once per `runId`; duplicate triggers
 * are deduplicated by the Workflow engine using the instance ID.
 */
export class HeartbeatWorkflow extends WorkflowEntrypoint<Env, HeartbeatParams> {
  async run(event: WorkflowEvent<HeartbeatParams>, step: WorkflowStep): Promise<void> {
    const { agentId, companyId, runId, taskId } = event.payload;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 1: Initialise the run record and mark it as running
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    await step.do("init-run", async () => {
      const id = this.env.AGENT_RUN_DO.idFromName(runId);
      const stub = this.env.AGENT_RUN_DO.get(id);

      // Initialise the run document in the DO
      const initResp = await stub.fetch("http://internal/init", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          runId,
          agentId,
          companyId,
          taskId,
          status: "running",
          startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          logCount: 0,
        }),
      });
      if (!initResp.ok) {
        throw new Error(`AgentRunDO init failed: HTTP ${initResp.status}`);
      }

      // If there is an associated task, update the TaskDO so the UI reflects
      // that a heartbeat is now running.
      if (taskId) {
        const taskId_ = this.env.TASK_DO.idFromName(taskId);
        const taskStub = this.env.TASK_DO.get(taskId_);
        await taskStub.fetch("http://internal/state", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            taskId,
            status: "running",
            currentStep: "heartbeat",
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          }),
        });
      }
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 2: Execute the heartbeat via the sandbox bridge
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    const executeResult = await step.do(
      "execute",
      {
        timeout: "5 minutes",
        retries: { limit: 2, delay: "5 seconds", backoff: "linear" },
      },
      async () => {
        // TODO: replace with the actual internal heartbeat API URL once
        // the HTTP adapter migration (PR #6/#7) lands. For now we call a
        // placeholder endpoint on the main Worker.
        const bridgeUrl =
          (await this.env.PAPERCLIP_KV.get("SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL")) ??
          "http://localhost:8788";
        const apiKey = await this.env.PAPERCLIP_KV.get("SANDBOX_BRIDGE_API_KEY");

        const resp = await fetch(`${bridgeUrl}/internal/heartbeat`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            ...(apiKey ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` } : {}),
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ agentId, companyId, runId, taskId }),
        });

        if (!resp.ok) {
          const body = await resp.text().catch(() => "(unreadable)");
          throw new Error(`Heartbeat execution failed: HTTP ${resp.status}: ${body}`);
        }

        return (await resp.json()) as { status: string; liveness?: string };
      },
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 3: Record the result in AgentRunDO and notify TaskDO
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    await step.do("record-result", async () => {
      const id = this.env.AGENT_RUN_DO.idFromName(runId);
      const stub = this.env.AGENT_RUN_DO.get(id);

      const succeeded = executeResult?.status !== "failed";
      await stub.fetch("http://internal/state", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          status: succeeded ? "succeeded" : "failed",
          completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        }),
      });

      // Update TaskDO so the UI reflects the completed heartbeat
      if (taskId) {
        const taskId_ = this.env.TASK_DO.idFromName(taskId);
        const taskStub = this.env.TASK_DO.get(taskId_);
        await taskStub.fetch("http://internal/state", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            taskId,
            status: succeeded ? "running" : "failed",
            currentStep: "idle",
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          }),
        });
      }
    });
  }
}
```

/**
 * boot.ts — Cloudflare deployment boot sequence.
 *
 * Registers all Cloudflare-specific service implementations into the shared
 * provider registries. Called once on first Worker request (or on every cold
 * start — all registrations are idempotent Map.set calls).
 *
 * This is the only file in `packages/deploy-cloudflare/` that touches the
 * server package's registry. Every other file in this package is self-contained.
 *
 * The import of `provider-registry` uses a workspace-relative path. Wrangler
 * (esbuild) resolves it through the workspace symlink at bundle time, so no
 * runtime module resolution occurs.
 *
 * NOTE: `server/src/storage/provider-registry.ts` must be free of Node-only
 * imports (it currently is — it only imports types). If that changes, this
 * import path will need to move to a standalone `@paperclipai/storage-core`
 * package (tracked as an optional follow-up to PR #2).
 */

import { registerStorageProvider } from "../../../server/src/storage/provider-registry.js";
import { R2Provider } from "./storage/r2-provider.js";

/**
 * Environment bindings required at boot time.
 */
export interface BootEnv {
  /** R2 bucket binding — declared as `PAPERCLIP_STORAGE` in wrangler.toml. */
  PAPERCLIP_STORAGE: R2Bucket;
  /**
   * Logical bucket name stored on object metadata (informational).
   * Defaults to `"paperclip-storage"` if absent.
   */
  STORAGE_R2_BUCKET?: string;
  /**
   * Optional key prefix applied to every stored object key.
   * Useful when sharing a single R2 bucket across multiple environments
   * (e.g. `"staging/"` vs `"prod/"`).
   */
  STORAGE_R2_PREFIX?: string;
}

/**
 * Registers the Cloudflare R2 storage provider with the shared provider
 * registry from `server/src/storage/provider-registry.ts`.
 *
 * After registration, calling `createStorageProviderFromConfig` with
 * `config.storageProvider === "r2"` returns an `R2Provider` backed by the
 * `PAPERCLIP_STORAGE` R2 bucket binding.
 *
 * The registry uses a plain `Map`; calling `bootCloudflare` multiple times
 * (e.g. on each warm-start invocation) is safe — subsequent calls overwrite
 * the previous factory with an equivalent one.
 *
 * @param env - The Worker environment bindings injected by the CF runtime.
 */
export function bootCloudflare(env: BootEnv): void {
  const bucketName = env.STORAGE_R2_BUCKET ?? "paperclip-storage";
  const prefix = env.STORAGE_R2_PREFIX ?? "";

  registerStorageProvider("r2", (_config) => {
    return new R2Provider(env.PAPERCLIP_STORAGE, { bucket: bucketName, prefix });
  });
}

import { Hono } from "hono";

/**
 * First-run setup Hono app.
 *
 * Served at `/setup` before `SETUP_COMPLETED` is set in KV. Collects the
 * secrets and credentials needed to run Paperclip and stores them in KV /
 * the `instance_settings` DB table. Once setup completes, all Workers read
 * config from the DB (encrypted with a master key stored as a Worker secret).
 *
 * Fields collected:
 *   - LLM API key (Anthropic and/or OpenAI)
 *   - Neon/Postgres connection string (Hyperdrive Phase 1)
 *   - Operator email and initial password
 *   - Optional: sandbox bridge URL and API key (for plugin execution)
 *
 * Security: this route is gated — it only accepts requests when
 * `SETUP_COMPLETED` is absent from KV (enforced by the middleware in
 * `api.ts`). After setup completes it permanently locks itself.
 */

interface SetupEnv {
  PAPERCLIP_KV: KVNamespace;
  HYPERDRIVE?: { connectionString: string };
}

interface SetupFormData {
  anthropicApiKey?: string;
  openaiApiKey?: string;
  neonConnectionString?: string;
  operatorEmail: string;
  operatorPassword: string;
  sandboxBridgeUrl?: string;
  sandboxBridgeApiKey?: string;
}

interface ValidationErrors {
  [field: string]: string;
}

function validateSetupForm(data: SetupFormData): ValidationErrors {
  const errors: ValidationErrors = {};

  if (!data.operatorEmail || !data.operatorEmail.includes("@")) {
    errors.operatorEmail = "A valid email address is required.";
  }
  if (!data.operatorPassword || data.operatorPassword.length < 12) {
    errors.operatorPassword = "Password must be at least 12 characters.";
  }
  if (!data.anthropicApiKey && !data.openaiApiKey) {
    errors.llmKey = "At least one LLM API key (Anthropic or OpenAI) is required.";
  }

  return errors;
}

function setupHtml(opts: {
  errors?: ValidationErrors;
  prefill?: Partial<SetupFormData>;
  success?: boolean;

import type { RequestHandler } from "express";
import type { Db } from "@paperclipai/db";
import type { StorageService } from "../storage/types.js";
import type { ActorContext, ActorMembership, Handler, RequestCtx } from "./types.js";

export interface AdapterDeps {
  db: Db;
  storage: StorageService;
}

/**
 * Wraps a transport-agnostic {@link Handler} as an Express {@link RequestHandler}.
 *
 * Bridging notes:
 * - `req.body` is already parsed by express.json(); json() returns it directly
 *   so the raw body is never re-parsed.
 * - Path params come from `req.params`, query params from `req.query`.
 * - `req.actor.type === "none"` is normalised to `null` so handlers can do a
 *   simple null-check rather than inspecting the string.
 * - The Web API `Response` returned by the handler is forwarded to Express `res`
 *   by copying status, headers, and body.
 */
export function expressHandler(handler: Handler, deps: AdapterDeps): RequestHandler {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      // Build the base URL from the incoming request. Express provides
      // req.hostname and req.originalUrl which together give us a fully-formed
      // URL object without needing the raw Host header gymnastics.
      const protocol = (req as { protocol?: string }).protocol ?? "http";
      const baseUrl = `${protocol}://${req.hostname}`;
      const url = new URL(req.originalUrl, baseUrl);

      // Translate the Express actor to ActorContext | null. "none" → null.
      const expressActor = req.actor;
      let actor: ActorContext | null = null;
      if (expressActor?.type === "board") {
        actor = {
          type: "board",
          source: expressActor.source as ActorContext["source"],
          userId: expressActor.userId ?? "unknown",
          userName: (expressActor as { userName?: string | null }).userName ?? null,
          userEmail: (expressActor as { userEmail?: string | null }).userEmail ?? null,
          isInstanceAdmin: Boolean((expressActor as { isInstanceAdmin?: boolean }).isInstanceAdmin),
          companyIds: (expressActor as { companyIds?: string[] }).companyIds,
          memberships: (expressActor as { memberships?: ActorMembership[] }).memberships,
          keyId: (expressActor as { keyId?: string }).keyId,
          runId: expressActor.runId,
        };
      } else if (expressActor?.type === "agent") {
        actor = {
          type: "agent",
          source: expressActor.source as ActorContext["source"],
          agentId: expressActor.agentId ?? "unknown",
          companyId: expressActor.companyId ?? "",
          keyId: (expressActor as { keyId?: string }).keyId,
          runId: expressActor.runId,
        };
      }

      // Build the Web-API-compatible Headers object from Express's incoming
      // headers map. Express lowercases all header names, so this is safe.
      const headers = new Headers();
      for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(req.headers)) {
        if (value === undefined) continue;
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
          for (const v of value) headers.append(name, v);
        } else {
          // value is string here; cast required because Object.entries loses
          // the discriminated IncomingHttpHeaders union.
          headers.set(name, value as string);
        }
      }

      const ctx: RequestCtx = {
        method: req.method,
        url,
        headers,

        // Body is already parsed by express.json() — just return the cached
        // object rather than re-serialising/re-parsing it.
        json<T = unknown>(): Promise<T> {
          return Promise.resolve(req.body as T);
        },
        text(): Promise<string> {
          if (typeof req.body === "string") return Promise.resolve(req.body);
          return Promise.resolve(JSON.stringify(req.body));
        },

        param(name: string): string | undefined {
          const value = req.params[name];
          return value === undefined ? undefined : String(value);
        },
        query(name: string): string | undefined {
          const value = req.query[name];
          if (value === undefined) return undefined;
          // Express query values can be string | ParsedQs | string[] | ParsedQs[]
          // We only surface the first scalar string.
          if (typeof value === "string") return value;
          if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            const first = value[0];
            return typeof first === "string" ? first : undefined;
          }
          return undefined;
        },

        actor,
        db: deps.db,
        storage: deps.storage,
      };

      const response = await handler(ctx);

      res.status(response.status);

      // Forward response headers (skip ones Express manages itself).
      response.headers.forEach((value, name) => {
        const lower = name.toLowerCase();
        if (lower === "transfer-encoding" || lower === "content-length") return;
        res.setHeader(name, value);
      });

      const body = await response.text();
      res.send(body);
    } catch (err) {
      next(err);
    }
  };
}
```

My approach: **Tag `expressHandler` wrappers, then walk the Express Router stack**.

This is practical because:

3. The CF Worker walks the router stack, finds tagged handlers, and mounts them on Hono

**Conversion rules:**
- `req.params.x` → `ctx.param("x")`

- `res.status(N).json(data)` → `return Response.json(data, { status: N })`
- `res.setHeader("Content-Type", "image/svg+xml"); res.send(svg)` → `return new Response(svg, { headers: { "Content-Type": "image/svg+xml" } })`
- `res.set("Cache-Control", ...); res.json(data)` → `return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "..." } })`

- `assertInstanceAdmin(req)` → `assertInstanceAdmin(ctx)`

### 2. NEW `packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/http/express-router-bridge.ts`

Walk an Express Router's `.stack` to extract `RouteDefinition[]`. Each layer in the stack has `.route.path`, `.route.methods`, and `.route.stack[n].handle`. The handle with `.__handler` is the tagged expressHandler wrapper.

```ts
import type { Handler, RouteDefinition } from "../../../../server/src/http/types.js";

type TaggedFn = ((...args: unknown[]) => unknown) & { __handler?: Handler };

interface RouterLayer {
  route?: {
    path: string;
    methods: Record<string, boolean>;
    stack: Array<{ handle: TaggedFn }>;
  };
  name?: string;
  handle?: { stack?: RouterLayer[] };
  regexp?: RegExp;
  keys?: Array<{ name: string }>;
}

function extractPathFromLayerRegexp(layer: RouterLayer): string {
  // Express stores the mounted path in layer.regexp.
  // Pattern: /^\/companies\/?(?=\/|$)/i → "/companies"
  if (!layer.regexp) return "";
  const src = layer.regexp.source;
  const m = src.match(/^\^\\\/(.+?)\\\/\?\(\?=\\\/\|\$\)/);
  if (m) return "/" + m[1].replace(/\\\//g, "/");
  return "";
}

export function extractRoutesFromRouter(
  routerObj: unknown,
  prefix = "",
): RouteDefinition[] {
  const router = routerObj as { stack?: RouterLayer[] };
  const defs: RouteDefinition[] = [];
  for (const layer of router.stack ?? []) {
    if (layer.route) {
      const path = prefix + layer.route.path;
      for (const [method, enabled] of Object.entries(layer.route.methods)) {
        if (!enabled) continue;
        for (const rl of layer.route.stack) {
          if (rl.handle.__handler) {
            defs.push({
              method: method.toUpperCase() as RouteDefinition["method"],
              path,
              handler: rl.handle.__handler,
            });
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (layer.name === "router" && layer.handle?.stack) {
      const nested = extractPathFromLayerRegexp(layer);
      defs.push(...extractRoutesFromRouter(layer.handle, prefix + nested));
    }
  }
  return defs;
}
```

70	          headers.set(name, value as string);

74	      const ctx: RequestCtx = {

76	        url,
77	        headers,
78	
79	        // Body is already parsed by express.json() — just return the cached
80	        // object rather than re-serialising/re-parsing it.
81	        json<T = unknown>(): Promise<T> {
82	          return Promise.resolve(req.body as T);
83	        },
84	        text(): Promise<string> {
85	          if (typeof req.body === "string") return Promise.resolve(req.body);
86	          return Promise.resolve(JSON.stringify(req.body));
87	        },
88

90	          const value = req.params[name];
91	          return value === undefined ? undefined : String(value);
92	        },

94	          const value = req.query[name];
95	          if (value === undefined) return undefined;
96	          // Express query values can be string | ParsedQs | string[] | ParsedQs[]
97	          // We only surface the first scalar string.
98	          if (typeof value === "string") return value;
99	          if (Array.isArray(value)) {
100	            const first = value[0];
101	            return typeof first === "string" ? first : undefined;
102	          }
103	          return undefined;
104	        },

106	        actor,

112	
113	      res.status(response.status);
114	
115	      // Forward response headers (skip ones Express manages itself).
116	      response.headers.forEach((value, name) => {
117	        const lower = name.toLowerCase();
118	        if (lower === "transfer-encoding" || lower === "content-length") return;
119	        res.setHeader(name, value);
120	      });
121	
122	      const body = await response.text();
123	      res.send(body);

196	  async queue(batch: MessageBatch<unknown>, env: Env): Promise<void> {
197	    for (const message of batch.messages) {
198	      const body = message.body as Record<string, unknown>;
199	      const type = body?.type as string | undefined;
200	
201	      if (type === "plugin_job_dispatch") {
202	        const pluginJobId = body.pluginJobId as string;
203	        const pluginSlug = body.pluginSlug as string;
204	        const companyId = body.companyId as string;
205	        const executorMode = (body.executorMode as "sandbox_bridge" | "container") ?? "sandbox_bridge";
206	
207	        try {
208	          await env.PLUGIN_DISPATCH_WORKFLOW.create({
209	            // Use the job ID as the Workflow instance ID for deduplication
210	            id: `plugin-job-${pluginJobId}`,
211	            params: { pluginJobId, pluginSlug, companyId, executorMode },
212	          });
213	          message.ack();
214	        } catch (err) {
215	          // Let the queue retry this message
216	          console.error(
217	            `[Queue] Failed to start PluginDispatchWorkflow for job ${pluginJobId}: ${
218	              err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
219	            }`,
220	          );
221	          message.retry();
222	        }
223	        continue;
224	      }
225	
226	      if (type === "heartbeat_dispatch") {
227	        const agentId = body.agentId as string;
228	        const companyId = body.companyId as string;
229	        const runId = body.runId as string;
230	        const taskId = body.taskId as string | undefined;
231	
232	        try {
233	          await env.HEARTBEAT_WORKFLOW.create({
234	            id: `heartbeat-${runId}`,
235	            params: { agentId, companyId, runId, taskId },
236	          });
237	          message.ack();
238	        } catch (err) {
239	          console.error(
240	            `[Queue] Failed to start HeartbeatWorkflow for run ${runId}: ${
241	              err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
242	            }`,
243	          );
244	          message.retry();
245	        }
246	        continue;
247	      }
248	
249	      // Unknown message type — ack to avoid infinite retries
250	      console.warn(`[Queue] Unknown message type: ${type}`);
251	      message.ack();
252	    }
253	  },
